items.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023
items.q: this music wouldn’t exist if somebody here in the West German radio wouldn’t take money and say to ... Jim McNeely ... say please write a program ... being part of this creation is quite something.

ctx.x: Nice. I wish we would learn from that.

Yes it really is amazing the system and the appreciation that it creates here for this music and I think often about how much music we have played over the years that would have never — wouldn’t exist if it weren’t for this because this music is always or almost always commissioned for the band. So this music wouldn’t exist if somebody here in the West German radio wouldn’t take money and say to Vince Mendoza or to Michael Abene or to Bob Mintzer or to Jim McNeely or whoever, say please write a program of Michel…
Was there a media announcement about the first girl in the WDR big band?
